title: World / Shadow Research Ownership Index
purpose: Prevent Farm/Swamp/Moloch/Sektur research from fragmenting across overlapping files. This index states which record owns which layer and where new discoveries should be promoted.

owners.boundary: Do not move modern empirical harassment claims here; this is comparative religion/esotericism.
Do not use internet-subculture anecdotes as proof of geopolitical or institutional claims.

promotion_rules: New empirical source → relevant source ledger first; then promote supported inference into canonical conceptual owner.
New Potatoverse symbol → canonical symbolic owner first; link empirical comparator second.
Named-person allegation → evidence ledger with source/date/status; never promote rumor as symbolic proof.
New FAQ → discovery file only after an answer has a canonical owner.
Do not create a new master file when an owner above can absorb the discovery.
When two files overlap, keep the more abstract relation in the structural atlas and the mechanism/evidence in the specialist owner.
Every promoted claim should preserve an epistemic class and at least one counter-boundary describing what the source does not establish.
current_high_value_questions: How does a target become permanently classifiable?
What is the difference between observation, documentation, gossip, harassment and reputational punishment?
When does a correction actually reach the audience that saw the original claim?
How much apparent corroboration is source duplication?
When does anti-fandom become structurally dependent on the target?
How does anonymity change group norm salience?
What happens to a network after deplatforming?
When does a conflict scene become self-sealing or high-control?
Can a participant leave a role—Cow, Dog, Farmer, enemy—without the archive continually restoring it?
Which Garden interventions reduce extraction while preserving legitimate criticism, evidence and accountability?
